title: core.style.sheet — styles and formatting defaults
description: The document's stylesheet: the document defaults and the named paragraph, character, table and list styles. Formatting is resolved in this order, later wins: reader defaults, `defaultChr` / `defaultPara`, the style chain from the root of `basedOn` down to the style, direct formatting. spec/PROFILE-RICH-DOCUMENT.md section 3. Lengths are points (1/72 inch).

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload schema: the constant 1.

defaultChr.description: Document defaults for character formatting: what a property not set by any style or direct formatting takes. A property null or absent here falls back to the reader's own default (an 11-point body font, black, no decoration).

defaultPara.description: Document defaults for paragraph formatting. A property null or absent here falls back to: left-aligned, no indents, no space before or after, single line spacing.

defaultParaPresent.description: true: the document states its paragraph defaults explicitly, even when `defaultPara` is empty; false: it states none and leaves them to the reader. Kept so that a stated-but-empty default is not confused with an unstated one.

styles.description: The styles, in their stored order. Style `id`s are unique.

Align.description: Horizontal alignment of text between the left and right indents. Values: `left`: flush left, ragged right (in a right-to-left paragraph: at the leading edge, which is the right); `center`: centred; `right`: flush right, ragged left; `justify`: both edges flush; the last line is left-aligned; `distribute`: both edges flush on every line, the last line included, by spacing characters.

color.description: Line colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: automatic (black on a light background).

space.description: Distance between the border and the content it surrounds, points (1/72 inch).

BorderStyle.description: The kind of line a border is drawn with. Values: `none`: no line (explicitly none: it overrides an inherited border); `single`: one solid line; `double`: two parallel solid lines; `dotted`: a line of dots; `dashed`: a line of dashes; `thick`: one heavy solid line; `triple`: three parallel solid lines; `dotDash`: alternating dots and dashes; `wave`: a wavy line.

Borders.description: Borders on the four sides, plus the inner borders of tables and of runs of bordered paragraphs. A side that is null is not set here.

top.description: The top border. Null: not set.

left.description: The left border. Null: not set.

bottom.description: The bottom border. Null: not set.

right.description: The right border. Null: not set.

between.description: Between consecutive paragraphs (paragraph borders), or between rows: the inside horizontal lines (table borders). Null: not set.

inside_v.description: Between columns: the inside vertical lines of a table. Null: not set.

CharProps.description: Character formatting, as direct formatting or in a style. Every property is optional; null or absent means the property is not set here and is inherited.

style.description: The `id` of a character style in the stylesheet node. Null or absent: none.

font.description: Font family name (for example `Aptos`, `Times New Roman`). A name only: the font file is not part of the document, and a reader without that font substitutes a similar one. Null or absent: inherited.

size.description: Font size, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

underline.description: Underline style (`none` explicitly removes an inherited underline). Null or absent: inherited.

underlineColor.description: Underline colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null or absent: the text colour.

strike.description: Struck through with one line. Null or absent: inherited.

doubleStrike.description: Struck through with two lines. Null or absent: inherited.

color.description: Text colour. Null or absent: inherited.

highlight.description: Highlighter colour behind the text (`none` explicitly removes an inherited one). Null or absent: inherited.

shading.description: Background fill behind the text, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null or absent: inherited.

border.description: A border around the text; a border whose `style` is `none` explicitly removes an inherited one. Null or absent: inherited.

vertAlign.description: Superscript or subscript. Null or absent: inherited.

caps.description: Shown in capitals (the stored text keeps its case). Null or absent: inherited.

smallCaps.description: Lower-case letters shown as small capitals. Null or absent: inherited.

hidden.description: Hidden text: not shown and not printed unless the reader is asked to show it. Null or absent: inherited.

spacing.description: Extra space after each character, points (1/72 inch); negative condenses. Null or absent: inherited.

scale.description: Horizontal scaling of the glyphs, percent (100 = unscaled). Null or absent: inherited.

position.description: Baseline shift, points (1/72 inch): positive raises the text, negative lowers it. Null or absent: inherited.

kern.description: Pair kerning is applied to text at or above this font size, points (1/72 inch); 0 = kerning off. Null or absent: inherited.

outline.description: Letters drawn as outlines. Null or absent: inherited.

shadow.description: Letters drawn with a simple drop shadow. Null or absent: inherited.

emboss.description: Letters drawn embossed (raised). Null or absent: inherited.

engrave.description: Letters drawn engraved (sunken). Null or absent: inherited.

textEffects.description: Decorative text effects: fill, outline, shadow, glow, reflection. When inherited values combine, each of the five is taken whole from the nearest level that sets it. Null or absent: inherited.

lang.description: Language of the text, a BCP 47 tag (`en-US`, `de-DE`). Null or absent: inherited.

noProof.description: true: spelling and grammar are not checked in this text. Null or absent: inherited.

rtl.description: true: a right-to-left run; its characters are complex script and read right to left. Null or absent: inherited.

cs.description: true: the whole run is formatted with the complex-script properties (`fontCs`, `sizeCs`, `boldCs`, `italicCs`). Null or absent: inherited.

fontCs.description: Font family name for complex-script text (Arabic, Hebrew, Thai ...). Null or absent: inherited, and `font` when nothing sets it.

fontEa.description: Font family name for East Asian text (Chinese, Japanese, Korean). Null or absent: inherited, and `font` when nothing sets it.

sizeCs.description: Font size for complex-script text, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

boldCs.description: Bold for complex-script text. Null or absent: inherited.

italicCs.description: Italic for complex-script text. Null or absent: inherited.

langBidi.description: Language of complex-script text, a BCP 47 tag (`fa-IR`). Null or absent: inherited.

link.description: Hyperlink target of the text: a URL, or `#name` for the bookmark `name` in this document. A link is content to follow on the reader's request, never a dependency of the document. Null or absent: not a link.

ins.description: The text is a tracked insertion made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `insert`). Null or absent: not a tracked insertion.

del.description: The text is a tracked deletion made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `delete`): it is still stored, and is shown struck through or hidden. Null or absent: not a tracked deletion.

fmtChange.description: Tracked formatting change: the formatting before the change, and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

Glow.description: A glow: a soft band of colour around the outline.

color.description: Glow colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

size.description: Width of the glow band around the outline, points (1/72 inch), 0..150.

GradStop.description: One colour stop of a gradient.

color.description: Colour at this position, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

Highlight.description: A highlighter colour behind text: one of sixteen fixed colours, or none. Values: `none`: No highlight (explicitly: removes an inherited one); `yellow`: #FFFF00; `brightGreen`: #00FF00; `turquoise`: #00FFFF; `pink`: #FF00FF; `blue`: #0000FF; `red`: #FF0000; `darkBlue`: #000080; `teal`: #008080; `green`: #008000; `violet`: #800080; `darkRed`: #800000; `darkYellow`: #808000; `gray50`: #808080; `gray25`: #C0C0C0; `black`: #000000; `white`: #FFFFFF.

LineSpacing.description: Line spacing: a rule and its value.

oneOf.description: A multiple of single line spacing.

value.description: The multiple of single line spacing (the font's natural line height): 1.0 = single, 1.5, 2.0 = double.

oneOf.description: At least a given line height.

value.description: The minimum line height, points (1/72 inch); taller content makes the line taller.
The exact line height, points (1/72 inch); taller content is clipped.

NumChange.description: A tracked change of a paragraph's list numbering.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes`.

original.description: The list label as it was shown before the change (for example `2.`).

NumRef.description: The list a paragraph belongs to, and its level in it.

num.description: The `id` of an entry of the numbering node's `nums`; 0 means no list (it removes numbering inherited from a style).

ParaProps.description: Paragraph formatting, as direct formatting or in a style. Every property is optional; null or absent means the property is not set here and is inherited.

style.description: The `id` of a paragraph style in the stylesheet node. Null or absent: the stylesheet's default paragraph style (`Normal` where it exists).

align.description: Horizontal alignment. Null or absent: inherited.

indentLeft.description: Left indent: distance from the text column's left edge to the paragraph's text, points (1/72 inch) (negative reaches into the margin). Null or absent: inherited.

indentRight.description: Right indent: distance from the paragraph's text to the text column's right edge, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

indentFirst.description: First-line indent relative to `indentLeft`, points (1/72 inch); negative: a hanging indent (the first line starts to the left of the others). Null or absent: inherited.

indentLeftChars.description: Left indent in characters, where one character is the font size of the paragraph mark. A non-zero value wins over `indentLeft`; 0 cancels an inherited value. Null or absent: inherited.

indentRightChars.description: Right indent in characters (as `indentLeftChars`). Null or absent: inherited.

indentFirstChars.description: First-line indent in characters; negative: hanging (as `indentLeftChars`). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceBefore.description: Space above the paragraph, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceAfter.description: Space below the paragraph, points (1/72 inch). Null or absent: inherited.

spaceBeforeAuto.description: true: the space above is automatic instead of `spaceBefore`: 14 points, none at the top of the document or of a table cell, collapsing with the space below the previous paragraph. Null or absent: inherited.

spaceAfterAuto.description: true: the space below is automatic instead of `spaceAfter`: 14 points, none at the end of a table cell. Null or absent: inherited.

lineSpacing.description: Line spacing. Null or absent: inherited.

contextualSpacing.description: true: no space is added between this paragraph and a neighbour of the same paragraph style. Null or absent: inherited.

mirrorIndents.description: true: the left and right indents are inside and outside indents, so they swap sides on even pages. Null or absent: inherited.

keepNext.description: Keep the paragraph on the same page as the next one. Null or absent: inherited.

keepLines.description: Keep all lines of the paragraph on one page. Null or absent: inherited.

pageBreakBefore.description: Start the paragraph on a new page. Null or absent: inherited.

widowControl.description: Never leave a single first or last line of the paragraph alone on a page. Null or absent: inherited.

outlineLevel.description: Outline level for the document's outline and table of contents: 0..8 = levels 1..9 (headings), 9 = body text. Null or absent: inherited.

numbering.description: The list the paragraph belongs to and its level; a `num` of 0 removes numbering inherited from a style. Null or absent: inherited.

tabs.description: Tab stops. The list REPLACES the inherited one, except that a stop with `align: clear` removes the inherited stop at its position. Null or absent: inherited.

shading.description: Background fill of the paragraph, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null or absent: inherited.

borders.description: Borders around the paragraph; `between` is drawn between consecutive paragraphs with the same borders, `inside_v` is unused. Null or absent: inherited.

suppressHyphens.description: Do not hyphenate this paragraph. Null or absent: inherited.

suppressLineNumbers.description: Skip this paragraph when numbering lines. Null or absent: inherited.

bidi.description: A right-to-left paragraph: its base direction is right to left, `left` alignment means the leading (right) edge, and the left and right indents swap sides. Null or absent: inherited.

dropCap.description: Drop cap: the number of lines the paragraph's first character(s) drop over (0 = none). Null or absent: inherited.

frame.description: A text frame: the paragraph is placed apart from the text flow, which may wrap around it. Null or absent: none.

kinsoku.description: East Asian line-breaking rules: no line starts with closing punctuation or ends with opening punctuation. Null or absent: inherited, and on when nothing sets it.

wordWrap.description: true: Latin words wrap whole; false: they may break at any character. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

overflowPunct.description: true: punctuation may hang past the end of the line. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

topLinePunct.description: true: punctuation at the start of a line is compressed. Null or absent: inherited, and false when nothing sets it.

autoSpaceDE.description: true: a small automatic space separates East Asian from Latin text. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

autoSpaceDN.description: true: a small automatic space separates East Asian text from numbers. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

numChange.description: Tracked change of the paragraph's list numbering. Null or absent: none.

fmtChange.description: Tracked formatting change: the paragraph properties before the change, and the tracked-change entry that made it. Null or absent: none.

snapToGrid.description: true: the paragraph's lines snap to the section's document grid. Null or absent: inherited, and true when nothing sets it.

PropChange_CharProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

PropChange_ParaProps.description: A tracked formatting change: the properties as they were BEFORE the change, and who changed them. The properties after the change are the ones the owner carries now.

rev.description: The change was made by the `id` of an entry of the `core.text.tracked-changes` node's `changes` (of kind `format`).

old.description: The properties before the change (formatting only).

Reflection.description: A mirror image of the letters below them that fades out.

transparency.description: Transparency of the reflection where it starts (nearest the letters), percent 0 (opaque) .. 100.

size.description: How much of the letters' height the reflection extends over before it has faded out, percent 0..100.

distance.description: Gap between the letters and the reflection, points (1/72 inch), 0..100.

blur.description: Blur radius of the reflection, points (1/72 inch), 0..100.

Rgb.description: A colour: `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), no alpha.

Shadow.description: An outer shadow: a blurred copy of the silhouette cast `distance` away in direction `angle`.

color.description: Shadow colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

distance.description: How far the shadow is cast from the shape, points (1/72 inch), 0..200.

angle.description: Direction the shadow is cast in, degrees clockwise from the positive x axis (0 = to the right, 90 = downwards), 0 <= angle < 360.

rotWithShape.description: true: `angle` is in the shape's own frame and turns with the shape when it is rotated or flipped; false: `angle` is in the page's frame.

Style.description: A named set of formatting that paragraphs, text runs, tables or lists refer to by `id`.

id.description: The style's identifier (`Heading1`): what paragraph and character formatting's `style`, a table's `style`, `basedOn`, `next` and `linked` refer to. Unique in the stylesheet; it never changes when the style is renamed.

basedOn.description: The `id` of the style this one inherits from: properties not set here come from it. Null: based on the document defaults.

next.description: The `id` of the style a new paragraph takes when it is started after a paragraph of this style. Null: this same style.

linked.description: The `id` of the character style linked to this paragraph style (or the reverse): the pair presents one style that can be applied to a paragraph or to text. Null: none.

para.description: The paragraph formatting the style sets (null properties are inherited through `basedOn`).

chr.description: The character formatting the style sets (null properties are inherited through `basedOn`).

priority.description: Position in style lists: lower numbers come first. Null: after all styles that have one.

quick.description: true: the style is offered in the short list of frequently used styles.

hidden.description: true: the style is not offered in style lists.

builtin.description: true: one of the application's built-in styles; a user interface does not let it be deleted. No effect on formatting.

locked.description: true: the style cannot be applied while the document restricts formatting (settings node, `protectFormatting`).

table.description: For a table style: its borders, shading and the conditional formats of header row, banding and so on. Null: none.

StyleKind.description: What a style applies to. Values: `paragraph`: whole paragraphs (paragraph and character formatting); `character`: runs of text (character formatting only); `table`: tables; `numbering`: lists (it names a numbering definition).

TabAlign.description: How text lines up at a tab stop. Values: `left`: the text starts at the stop; `center`: the text is centred on the stop; `right`: the text ends at the stop; `decimal`: the decimal separator of a number sits at the stop; `bar`: no text alignment: a vertical bar is drawn at the stop's position; `clear`: not a stop: it removes the stop inherited at this position.

TabLeader.description: The characters that fill the space a tab jumps over. Values: `none`: nothing; `dot`: full stops (.....); `hyphen`: hyphens (-----); `underscore`: a solid underline (_____); `middleDot`: middle dots (·····).

pos.description: Position of the stop, points (1/72 inch) from the text column's left edge (not from the paragraph's indent).

align.description: How text after the tab lines up at the stop.

leader.description: The characters that fill the space the tab jumps over.

TableStyleParts.description: The formatting a table style gives a table: borders, shading and margins for the whole table, and special formats for its header row, total row, first and last column and bands. Which special formats apply to a given table is decided by that table's `look`.

borders.description: Borders of the whole table: outer sides, `between` (inside horizontal), `inside_v` (inside vertical). Null: none.

fill.description: Shading of every cell of the table, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

cellMargins.description: Inner margins of the table's cells `[top, left, bottom, right]`, points (1/72 inch). Null: not set by the style.

headerFill.description: Shading of the header (first) row's cells, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

headerChr.description: Character formatting of text in the header (first) row.

headerBorders.description: Cell borders of the header (first) row: `between` is the border between header rows, `inside_v` the border between its cells. Null: none.

bandFill.description: Shading of the odd row bands (the 1st, 3rd … band of `bandSize` rows, not counting the header row), `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

bandChr.description: Character formatting of text in the odd row bands.

bandBorders.description: Cell borders of the odd row bands. Null: none.

bandSize.description: Number of rows in one band. Null: 1.

firstColChr.description: Character formatting of text in the first column.

totalChr.description: Character formatting of text in the total (last) row.

totalBorderTop.description: The border above the total (last) row. Null: none.

firstColFill.description: Shading of the first column's cells, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

firstColBorders.description: Cell borders of the first column. Null: none.

lastColFill.description: Shading of the last column's cells, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

lastColChr.description: Character formatting of text in the last column.

lastColBorders.description: Cell borders of the last column. Null: none.

totalFill.description: Shading of the total (last) row's cells, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

totalBorders.description: Cell borders of the total (last) row; a top edge left unset falls back to `totalBorderTop`. Null: none.

colBandFill.description: Shading of the odd column bands (1st, 3rd … column), `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: none.

colBandChr.description: Character formatting of text in the odd column bands.

colBandBorders.description: Cell borders of the odd column bands. Null: none.

TextColor.description: A text colour: the string `Auto`, or `{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`.

oneOf.description: The string `Auto`: automatic colour, black on a light background and white on a dark one.
`{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`: a fixed colour, each component an integer 0..255, sRGB.

Rgb.description: `{"Rgb": [red, green, blue]}`: a fixed colour, each component an integer 0..255, sRGB.

TextEffects.description: Decorative effects on a run's letters. An effect that is null or absent is not applied.

fill.description: How the letters are filled. Null or absent: with the text colour.

outline.description: The line around the letters. Null or absent: none.

shadow.description: A shadow behind the letters. Null or absent: none.

glow.description: A glow around the letters. Null or absent: none.

reflection.description: A mirror image below the letters. Null or absent: none.

TextFill.description: How letters are filled. `type` selects the kind.

oneOf.description: Not filled: hollow letters, only their outline shows.

color.description: Fill colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB.

oneOf.description: A linear gradient across the run's letters.

stops.description: The colour stops, at least one, in order of `pos`.

angle.description: Direction of the gradient, degrees, 0 <= angle < 360: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom.

TextFrame.description: A text frame: the paragraph is placed apart from the text flow, in a box of its own. Lengths are points (1/72 inch).

w.description: Width of the frame. Null: as wide as its text.

h.description: Height of the frame: exact when `hExact` is true, otherwise a minimum. Null: as tall as its text.

hExact.description: true: `h` is the exact height; false: `h` is a minimum.

x.description: Horizontal offset from the `h_anchor` reference, points (1/72 inch); used when `xAlign` is null.

y.description: Vertical offset from the `v_anchor` reference, points (1/72 inch); used when `yAlign` is null.

xAlign.description: Horizontal alignment within the `hAnchor` area: `left`, `center`, `right`, `inside` or `outside`; takes precedence over `x`. Null: use `x`.

yAlign.description: Vertical alignment within the `vAnchor` area: `top`, `center`, `bottom`, `inside` or `outside`; takes precedence over `y`. Null (or `inline`): use `y`.

hAnchor.description: What `x` is measured from: `text` (the text column), `margin` or `page`. Empty: `text`.

vAnchor.description: What `y` is measured from: `text` (the paragraph's own position), `margin` or `page`. Empty: `text`.

wrap.description: How surrounding text treats the frame: `around` (wraps around it), `auto` (wraps when there is room), `notBeside` (no text beside it), `none`, `tight` or `through`. Empty: wrapping is the reader's choice (this writer wraps text around the frame when there is room).

hSpace.description: Distance kept from the surrounding text at the left and right, points (1/72 inch).

vSpace.description: Distance kept from the surrounding text above and below, points (1/72 inch).

color.description: Line colour, `[red, green, blue]`, each an integer 0..255, sRGB. Null: explicitly no line.

Underline.description: Underline style. Values: `none`: no underline; `single`: one line under everything, spaces included; `words`: one line under words only, not under spaces; `double`: two lines; `thick`: one heavy line; `dotted`: a dotted line; `dash`: a dashed line; `dotDash`: alternating dots and dashes; `dotDotDash`: two dots then a dash, repeated; `wave`: a wavy line; `doubleWave`: two wavy lines.

VertAlign.description: Vertical position of text relative to the line. Values: `baseline`: on the baseline (explicitly: it removes an inherited superscript or subscript); `superscript`: raised and reduced: a superscript; `subscript`: lowered and reduced: a subscript.
